text:
rachel: Quick heads-up — found plaintext service account token in partner webhook logs (s3-forwarder). Looks like long-lived key for svc-backup-forwarder. Need immediate containment + rotation. Proposing ephemeralize tokens, rewrap KMS blobs, and run a Vault audit sweep. Who can own?

sam: Ack. Can take emergency revoke of the long-lived key and coord redeploy.

sec-oncall: Starting containment now. Revoke plan: 1) disable current key in IAM, 2) revoke Vault lease if present, 3) block service account in RBAC. Will post commands/results.

mike: I can switch the deployment to workload-identity + short TTL creds. ETA ~45m for canary.

ana: (typo) meant to say ana — I can handle KMS rewrap and wrapping-key rotate. Need the ciphertext blob IDs.

rachel: log snippet: ```
2026-03-22T14:02:11Z INFO forwarder: payload sent to partner url=https://hooks.partner.example token=ya29.ABCD... svc=svc-backup-forwarder key=KEY-abc123
```

sam: Command I'm running: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY-abc123 --iam-account=svc-backup-forwarder@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com` then `kubectl -n infra set env deploy/forwarder SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN=\"\"`

sec-oncall: Vault lookup: `vault kv get -mount=secret infra/bridge/svc-bkup` shows lease_id=lease-77a. Revoke with `vault lease revoke lease-77a`. Doing it now.

vault-bot: Audit log event: principal=schema-sync@redwood triggered read on secret infra/bridge/svc-bkup at 2026-03-22T13:58:42Z

ana: KMS notes: will rewrap blobs with new wrapping key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ephemeral-ring/cryptoKeys/rewrap-key`. After rewrap we should rotate the wrapping key version and update Vault transit config.

sam: After revoke, I'll create a short-lived SA key by binding to Workload Identity and issuing token via metadata server. Use TTL 1h.

mike: Canary deploy done (10% traffic) with workload identity — no errors so far. Rolling to 50% in 15m if metrics look good.

devops: I added a temporary deny rule in IAM for svc-backup-forwarder to prevent any accidental long-lived key creation. Policy change ID: policy-20260322-01.

rachel: Great. Action items: 
- sam: confirm revoke + post evidence (vault and gcloud cmd output) — owner
- ana: rewrap KMS blobs and rotate wrapping key, update Vault transit conf — owner
- mike: complete canary and full rollout to workload identity — owner
- devops: keep temporary deny rule until audit done — owner
- sec-oncall: run audit query for past 30d for accesses to infra/bridge/* and share findings — owner
Timeline: emergency containment within 1h, full cutover to ephemeral creds in 3h, postmortem later tonight.

sec-oncall: Running the audit query now: `vault audit list-reads --path "infra/bridge/*" --since 30d` — will paste results.

sam: Paste of revoke output: ```
Deleted key [KEY-abc123].
```

rachel: Thanks. Once ana confirms rewrap and mike confirms zero errors we can mark incident contained and start rotation sweep across similar forwarders. :white_check_mark:

ana: Rewrap complete. Updated transit key in Vault to use `rewrap-key@v2`. Pushed config, tested decrypt/encrypt, and rotated wrapping key version.

mike: Full rollout complete, metrics stable.

sec-oncall: Audit results: found 2 read events by integration-ci@partner on 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-20. Both are now blocked due to deny rule. Exporting CSV to #eng-security-private.

rachel: OK closing containment. Follow-up: run org-wide scan for similar plaintext tokens in partner logs and schedule rotation sweep for any service accounts with keys older than 7d. I'll own the sweep.

devops: Adding ticket INFRA-4021 for global scan + automation to ephemeralize long-lived keys.

sam: Thx all — will attach logs to the ticket.

rachel: Great. Postmortem tonight 20:00 UTC. :clipboard:
